datapack.minimalism_leaf_decay.tags: Disable this datapack to disable Minimalism Leaf Decay
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.minimalis:
Make leaves immediately decay!

Blocks in block tag minimalism_leaf_decay:schedule_random and not in minimalism_leaf_decay:schedule_random_blacklist will execute random tick after executing schedule tick, defaultly contains all leaves.
tag.block.minimalism_leaf_decay.schedule: Execute random tick after executing schedule tick
Blacklist of Execute random tick after executing schedule tick
